title: Xitsundzuxo Lexi tsariweke hi Vutlhari
intro: Anakanya u yime etlhelo ka xifaniso lexi nga tiviwiki hi masingita kumbe mimfumo, kambe hi marito lama ha kongomisaka timbilu ninamuntlha. Nandza loyi wa Allah u amukele nyiko ya risima naswona u chele ku nkhensa eka ndzayo yin’wana ni yin’wana leyi nyikeriweke xichudeni lexitsongo lexi rhandzekaka.
clues: Ndzi katekisiwile hi Allah hi vutlhari, naswona ndzi lerisiwe ku tlangela hikwalaho ka byona.
Ndzi vulavule ni n’wana wa mina hi xitsundzuxo xa rirhandzu, ndzi lemukisa hi rirhandzu ni ku khathala.
Ndzi byele n’wana wa mina leswaku ku hlanganisa vatirhisani na Allah i xihoxo lexikulu swinene.
Ndzi tsundzuxe n’wana wa mina leswaku a simeka xikhongelo, a lerisa leswinene, a yirisa leswo biha ni ku tiyisela hi ku lehisa mbilu.
Ndzi tsundzuxe n’wana wa mina leswaku a nga hundzuluxi marhama hi ku tikukumuxa kumbe ku famba emisaveni hi ku tikukumuxa.
Ndzi dyondzise n’wana wa mina ku va ni rivilo leri ringaniseriweke ni ku hunguta rito, hikuva mimpfumawulo yo tika swinene i ku rila ka timbhongolo.

identity.label: Xana Ndzi mani?
options: Dhul-Kifl Muvabyi
Luqman wa Vutlhari
Munhu wa Tijarateni Timbirhi
Tubba Mufumi
Khidr Mukongomisi

trial.label: Xitsundzuxo Xa Mina Lexikulu
options: Ku tsundzuxa n’wana wa mina ku lwisana na ku tihlanganisa na vanghana na Allah
Ku aka ngalava leswaku u pona ndhambi leyikulu
Ku hlamusela norho wa mufumi loko a ri ekhotsweni
Ku langutana na Faro hi swikombiso swa masingita
Ku mitiwa hi nhlampfi leyikulu elwandle
trial.answer: Ku tsundzuxa n’wana wa mina ku lwisana na ku tihlanganisa na vanghana na Allah

location.label: Nyiko Leyi Nyikiweke Eka Mina
options: Nhonga leyi hundzukeke nyoka
Vutlhari na ku nkhensa eka Allah
Xiluvelo lexi rhwariweke hi ku copeta ka tihlo
Areka ya mapulanga ya gopher
Ntanga wa ti date-palms na mirhi ya madiriva
location.answer: Vutlhari na ku nkhensa eka Allah

outcome.label: Ndlela Leyi Ndzi Tsundzukiwaka Ha Yona
options: Tanihi leswi munhu a nwileke eka ndhambi hikwalaho ka ku nga tshembi
Tanihi munhu loyi a mitiwaka hi misava hikwalaho ka ku tikukumuxa
Tanihi xikombiso xa ku tlangela ni ndzayo ya vutlhari ya vatswari
Ku fana ni loyi a lovisiweke hi ku buluka lokukulu loku humaka empfhukeni
Tanihi leswi munhu a hundzukeke hikwalaho ko tlula Savata
outcome.answer: Tanihi xikombiso xa ku tlangela ni ndzayo ya vutlhari ya vatswari

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
